```plato

    // Butterfly's new point on one edge: 1/2 to each endpoint, 1/8 to each apex and
    // -1/16 to each of the four wings. Where the stencil runs off a boundary the
    // scheme has no rule of its own, so the point falls back to Loop's, which is
    // defined everywhere.
    ButterflyEdgePoint(self: TriangleMesh3D, topology: TriangleMeshTopology, e: Integer): Point3D
    {
        var pair = topology.UndirectedEdges[e];
        var near = self.EdgeApex(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e));
        var far = self.EdgeFarApex(topology, UndirectedEdgeIndex(e));
        var ends = self.Positions[pair.A.Value].PositionVector + self.Positions[pair.B.Value].PositionVector;
        var apexes = far.IsNone
            ? Vector3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            : self.Positions[near.Value].PositionVector + self.Positions[far.Value].PositionVector;
        return self.HasFullButterflyStencil(topology, e)
            ? (ends * 0.5 + apexes * 0.125 - self.ButterflyWingSum(topology, e) * 0.0625).ToPoint
            : self.LoopEdgePoint(topology, e);
    }
```
